en.summary: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea is Natsume's next mainline entry in the long-running farming-sim series, releasing September 24, 2026 on Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC — the franchise's first appearance on Switch 2. Raised in Bloomfield Village, the player investigates a mysterious mist spreading from the Forest of Echoes alongside a childhood friend, restoring farms and communities across the wider region of Teradea while taming the wild wolves the mist has unleashed.

guideSections.title: Animal Companions & Expanded Movement
guideSections.description: Beyond traditional farming, players travel with animal companions that each grant unique traversal abilities (breaking obstacles, reaching hidden ledges), combined with an expanded moveset that adds jumping, ladder-climbing, and vine-scaling to the usual Harvest Moon toolkit.

guideSections.title: Romance & Guardian Spirits
guideSections.description: Echoes of Teradea offers ten romanceable villagers (five bachelors, five bachelorettes) alongside a main story built around helping the region's Guardian Spirits and the Harvest Goddess restore balance to Teradea.
